title: Two shirts, one overlap
hook: Two wet shirts overlap on the line. Does that hide any cloth from the air?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: that where two pieces of cloth overlap, that area is hidden from the air and dries last

misconception: Overlapping clothes on a rack dry as fast as separated ones, because the same cloth is out.
objective: Overlap hides the contacting regions from surrounding air. Separating the illustrated sheets restores those regions, although the total amount of cloth stays the same.

recall.question: Two 100 × 60 cm sheets hang with a 20 cm overlap along their 60 cm edges. How much face area does the overlap hide?
options: None: all the cloth is still there
recall.why: Both touching faces are hidden from the air: 2 × 20 × 60 = 2400 cm². The amount of cloth is unchanged; its exposed area is not.
